title: Lightweight transformer driven segmentation of defects in solar PV thermal imagery
mechanism: Customised SegFormer (hierarchical transformer encoder, light MLP decoder) for thermal defect segmentation on small data.
evidence: R (full text read): 277 drone IR images, 221/28/28 random split, all from 7 flights over the same 4 panels; SegFormer-B2 mIoU 0.86, custom 0.83, U-Net 0.76, DeepLabv3 0.80, Mask2Former 0.62. S: within-panel leakage, so the ranking is weak evidence.
adaptation: SegFormer-B2 encoder, 1-ch EL copied to 3 channels, 512 px, house augmentation; its 1/4-resolution output will blur 1 to 2 px cracks, so add a full-resolution refinement head (or U-Net-style skip from a stem conv) and judge on relF1@2 as well as strict IoU.
min_experiment: Arm SegFormer-B2 + full-res refinement head, AdamW 6e-5, 20k steps, 3 seeds; baseline house U-Net++ and PF; metrics test clean-49 relF1@2, crack IoU, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; kill if relF1@2 < house minus 0.01 and mIoU_rob not above house. Keep as a benchmark row regardless.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF 5: no transformer segmenter has been run; foundation-encoder tests were frozen probes and one ConvNeXt-T PF screen.
